_comment: Tab-reuse swap config — used by both asia/scripts/premarket_asia.mjs (flips US→HK at the start of an Asia session) and root premarket_setup.mjs (flips HK→US at the start of a US session). The TradingView Plus plan limits the number of tabs; this script reuses 3 US-equity tab slots for HK single-stock options when running the Asia session, and flips them back for US. Each pair holds either side but not both at any given time.
